description: 在行业活动里自然搭话、找到共同点、留下后续联系的钩子，而不是交换完名片就没下文。

targetChunks.note: 最多人用的搭话方式，比 Can I sit here 更随意，也适用于站着聊天。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Mind if I join you? I don't know anyone here yet.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 介意我加入吗？我在这儿还不认识人。

targetChunks.note: 活动破冰万能句；比 Why are you here 自然得多。
targetChunks.exampleEn: So what brings you here? Are you with one of the sponsors?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 你怎么会来？是赞助方的人吗？

targetChunks.en: I'm in product marketing — what about you?
targetChunks.note: I'm in + 行业/职能，简短自然；句尾 what about you 让对话继续。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm in product marketing — what about you?

targetChunks.en: How do you know the host?
targetChunks.note: 找共同关系的常用句，比 Do you know the host 更具体。
targetChunks.exampleEn: How do you know the host? We used to work together.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 你怎么认识主办人？我们以前是同事。

targetChunks.en: I've been meaning to check this event out.
targetChunks.zh: 我一直想来这个活动看看。
targetChunks.note: have been meaning to = 一直打算；显得你有关注，也给对方接话空间。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I've been meaning to check this event out for a while.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 这个活动我一直想来看看。

targetChunks.note: 比 What do you do 更松弛，适合活动而不是面试。
targetChunks.exampleEn: What's been keeping you busy these days?

targetChunks.en: That sounds right up my alley.
targetChunks.note: up one's alley = 正对胃口/专长；表达兴趣比 That's interesting 更具体。
targetChunks.exampleEn: You work on brand strategy? That sounds right up my alley.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 你做品牌策略？那正合我意。

targetChunks.en: We should grab a coffee sometime.
targetChunks.note: 社交收尾的模糊邀约；不必当场定时间，重点是留钩子。
targetChunks.exampleEn: We should grab a coffee sometime and compare notes.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 改天一起喝杯咖啡，交流一下。

targetChunks.note: details 可指邮箱、微信、LinkedIn，比 Give me your number 不唐突。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Let me get your details and I'll send you the deck.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 留个联系方式，我把材料发你。

targetChunks.en: I'll send you a quick follow-up.
targetChunks.note: follow-up 在职场社交里很常用；给后续联系一个明确理由。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'll send you a quick follow-up with the studio's portfolio.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我回头把工作室的作品集发你。

targetChunks.en: It was great chatting with you.
targetChunks.note: 比 Nice to meet you 更适合聊过一阵后告别；chatting 更口语。
targetChunks.exampleEn: It was great chatting with you — let's stay in touch.

targetChunks.note: mingle = 在社交场合走动交谈；体面退出对话，不显得不耐烦。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'll let you mingle — I'm sure we'll cross paths again.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 你先去转转，我们肯定还会碰到。

roleplay.promptZh: 你在一个行业酒会上，想认识做产品的人。先自然加入对话，找到共同点，最后留联系方式并礼貌退出。
roleplay.promptEn: At an industry mixer, join a conversation, find common ground, exchange details, and make a graceful exit.
goals: 用 Mind if I join you 自然加入
用 follow-up 留下后续联系的钩子

script.speaker: other
script.en: This place is packed tonight. Have you tried the food?
script.zh: 今晚人真多。你尝过吃的了吗？

script.speaker: you
script.en: Not yet — I've been meaning to. Mind if I join you?
script.zh: 还没，我一直想去拿。介意我加入你们吗？

script.speaker: other
script.en: Of course. So what brings you here?

script.speaker: you
script.en: I'm in product marketing. How about you?

script.speaker: other
script.en: I run a small design studio. Mostly tech clients.
script.zh: 我经营一家小设计工作室，主要做科技客户。

script.speaker: you
script.en: That's right up my alley. I've been looking for a studio for our rebrand.
script.zh: 那正合我意。我们品牌重塑一直想找工作室。

script.speaker: other
script.en: Oh, perfect timing. I'll send you a follow-up with some work.
script.zh: 那太巧了。我回头把作品发你。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Great. Let me get your details. It was great chatting with you — I'll let you mingle.
script.zh: 好。留个联系方式吧。聊得很开心，你先去转转。
